result:
Solution 2 is the one whose answer I believe is correct. Its lower-bound construction checks out, but its argument that n = 6 works is not a proof, so the answer rests partly on a plausibility judgment.

**Why n ≤ 5 fails.** Take the digit sequence with period 4 and pattern (n−1)·(+,+,−,−,…). Writing z = 1/c, its generating series is (n−1)(z+z²)/(1+z²). Setting 1 + (n−1)(z+z²)/(1+z²) = 0 gives the equation c² + (n−1)c + n = 0 in c.

- The roots have |c|² = n and Re c = −(n−1)/2.
- Hence |c−1|² = |c|² − 2 Re c + 1 = n + (n−1) + 1 = 2n exactly.
- The roots are non-real when (n−1)² < 4n, which holds for n ≤ 5. In that case c lies in M_n, is non-real, and satisfies |c−1| = √(2n), so it is not in X_n because the inequality is strict.
- Therefore n = 2, 3, 4, 5 all fail.

**Why n = 6 plausibly works.** For n = 6 the same construction gives c² + 5c + 6 = 0, which has real roots −2 and −3, so it no longer gives a non-real counterexample. I tested several other families at n = 6 (digits up to 5):

- Period-4 sequences (a, b, −a, −b) give |c−1|² = a+b+2. The non-real condition is a² < 4(b+1), and the maximum is 11 < 12.
- Antiperiodic period-3 sequences give small values, roughly 1 to 3.
- Candidates with a small positive real root, which could give large |c−1|², turned out to have all-real roots in the case I checked.

The role of the ++−− construction as the tight example, with exact equality at |c−1|² = 2n, fits the definition of X_n and suggests the containment holds from n = 6 on. I did not verify every sequence, so this part is a plausibility argument.

**The other solutions.**

- Solution 1 claims failures up to n = 15 using cubic computations that ignore the requirement that all roots lie outside the closed unit disk. Its sample cubics (e.g. c³ + 8c² + 15c − 16 with real root r ≈ 0.744) have a root with |c| < 1, so they are not valid elements of M_n.
- Solution 3 admits that its n = 5 computation gives |c−1|² ≈ 12.3 > 10. That is a counterexample to its own answer, and the construction above also contradicts it directly.

CHOICE: 2
